title: Elisha receives a double portion of Elijah's spirit
description: Elisha follows Elijah all the way to his ascension and asks for a double portion of his spirit. Elijah is taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire, and Elisha picks up his cloak and parts the Jordan River.
